title: Governance Mode
description: Operating mode for a governance agent. Controls whether findings block execution.

enumDescriptions.audit: Log all checks. Findings are recorded and the governance agent returns approved, except in two cases that hold in every mode: plans with human_review_required: true escalate, and a failed approved_sellers or delegations evaluation is denied.
enumDescriptions.advisory: Flag issues and return findings, but do not block execution. Human reviews happen post-hoc. The same two exceptions apply as in audit mode.
enumDescriptions.enforce: Block on denied or escalated. Require resolution before proceeding.
